pr_title: pid1: introduce dbus properties WatchdogDevice and friends

issue_context.title: Hardware Watchdog information
issue_context.body:
### Component

systemd

### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe

When setting up a hardware watchdog, it would be helpful if there was some way I could ask systemd if the watchdog was configured and any applicable settings.

Because systemd has the `/dev` node open, `wdctl` can't get information about it.

### Describe the solution you'd like

Output similar to what `wdctl` provides from one of the existing tools would be great.  Exposure over dbus might also be nice.

### Describe alternatives you've considered

_No response_

### The systemd version you checked that didn't have the feature you are asking for

_No response_
